eval: board: Codex-style discoverability + adversarial code review

discoverability_non_claude.note: mgl --help -> mgl board (23-line guide) -> serve/show/edit/render: an agent with only a terminal reaches start, URL, read, propose, climb in ~8 commands. Every docs/reference/board.md example ran with exit 0 from dist. Gaps: human canvas edits invisible to show; no `mgl docs <board op>`; history truncates silently at 12 and has no `by`.

correctness.note: op validation is strong (atomic, revalidated, cycles and duplicate ids caught, SSE closes cleanly, image src contained), but a self-bound arrow causes a stack overflow, --host 0.0.0.0 breaks server discovery, still cache ignores media files, absolute project path broken in the CLI.

security.note: Loopback default, Host allow-list (DNS rebinding) and Origin check on writes verified; traversal on /files, /app, /api/image and image src refused. Remaining: side-effecting GET /api/still is cross-site triggerable (CPU, disk, spend rows); 413 never delivered.

contract_adherence.note: Ops, routes, CLI table, ladder, advice match BOARD.md; shared/ imports nothing; no new deps; no browser launched. Deviations: HTTP by defaults to human for non-page clients; render ignores budget.maxLevel/cpuMin; serve exits 130/143 instead of 0/1/2.

code_quality.note: Dense, house style, codes+fixes everywhere; board tests 84/84 and tsc clean. Duplicated projectOf/outlineFor path logic (join vs resolve), model bounds() lacks the depth guard shared/shapes.ts has, every MglError with problems prints twice.

discoverability_walk: mgl board edit video.mgl.json round.open ... ; round.option x2

findings.title: --host 0.0.0.0: CLI cannot find its own server; printed URL is refused
findings.evidence: serve --host 0.0.0.0 writes url http://0.0.0.0:P to server.json; findServer GET /api/view -> 403 E_HOST; `mgl board view` -> E_NO_SERVER exit 1; `say` writes the file directly (no toast)
findings.fix: When bound to 0.0.0.0/::, write http://127.0.0.1:P to server.json and print it (plus the LAN/tunnel hint); keep 0.0.0.0 out of the URL.

findings.title: Self/arrow-bound arrow causes stack overflow (board poisoned)
findings.evidence: shape.add arrow from=n1; shape.set a1 from=a1 (accepted); shape.add rect -> E_INTERNAL Maximum call stack size exceeded
findings.fix: Reject arrow from/to that is itself, an arrow or a pin in shape.add/shape.set; add the depth guard of shared shapeBounds to State.bounds/endPoint.

findings.title: Cross-site GET /api/still burns CPU and writes spend rows
findings.evidence: curl -H 'Origin: http://evil.example' -H 'Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site' '/api/still?t=1.1s&w=8192' -> 200, 3.3 s render, spend row c1 by human; any page can do this with
findings.fix: In guard(): refuse when Sec-Fetch-Site is cross-site/same-site (except navigations to /), or require Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site same-origin for /api/still; cap w at full comp width.

findings.title: Still cache key ignores referenced media
findings.evidence: project with --media a.png (red); render --level 1; overwrite a.png blue; render --level 1 -> '1 from cache', pixel still red
findings.fix: Include size+mtime (or hash) of each referenced asset file in the key and in openCached's hash.

findings.title: Person's canvas work invisible to show; agent undo silently reverts it
findings.evidence: edit shape.add note text=... --by human; show | grep -c text -> 0; edit undo -> 'undid: shape.add note' (by human), no warning; history has no by
findings.fix: show: a 'person since your last op' line (recent shapes/edits by human); history summaries carry by; undo warns or needs --force when the step is by the other party.

findings.title: shape.set lets a pin target itself or an arrow
findings.evidence: pin.add n1; shape.set p1 target=p1 -> applied; show lists 'p1 on p1'
findings.fix: Apply pin.add's target checks in shape.set.

findings.title: POST /api/ops without by is recorded as human
findings.evidence: curl POST {ops:[say]} -> log m1 by human
findings.fix: Require by, or default to ai for non-page clients.

findings.title: 413 never reaches the client
findings.evidence: 2 MB POST /api/ops -> curl code=100, no body
findings.fix: Stop reading, send 413 with connection: close, destroy after finish.

findings.title: Absolute board.project breaks CLI (path.join)
findings.evidence: project=/abs/v.mgl.json -> show: 'project does not load (E_NO_FILE: tmp/...)'
findings.fix: Use linkedProject (resolve) in outlineFor and session.projectOf.

findings.title: render ignores brief budget.maxLevel and cpuMin
findings.evidence: maxLevel=1 cpuMin=0.01; render --level 3 renders with no budget warning; show then says 948 %
findings.fix: Before rendering, warn (or refuse without --force) above maxLevel or over cpuMin.

findings.title: serve exits 130/143 on signal, even with --json
findings.fix: Let the CLI own signals: startBoardServer takes handleSignals:false.

findings.title: history truncates at 12 silently; errors print twice
findings.evidence: 13 undo steps, 12 listed, no '… more'; every E_DUPLICATE_ID/E_REF error prints message then the same problem again
findings.fix: Add '… N more (--json)'; skip problems[0] when it equals the message.
